unit_of_comparison: Four-query cumulative sequence per issuer and arm, including all triggered work

baseline.requirement: Fresh independent tenant, normal upload, zero pre-existing facts; no fact publication/experience building. Ordinary supported answers still required.

build.requirement: Fresh independent tenant and normal upload; experience may only originate from this arm ordinary requests/builds.

controls: Same service instance/project cost ledger, provider/model/config/schema/prompt/price snapshot, source PDF bytes and selected pages across arms
Quality tenants and both arm tenants isolated; no gold or evaluation content in model/tool inputs
Run sequentially; await all foreground/background/retry jobs to terminal and ledger reconciliation before next step
Record actual cold/hot/reuse outcomes, not requested build flag as proof
No provider-cache flush or artificial prefix warmup; record input cache-hit/miss usage where supplied. Counterbalancing only partly limits provider-cache/time-order confounding.
record_per_step: foreground latency and end-to-end settled latency
all attributable call attempt IDs and stage/foreground/background/retry category
input/output/cache-hit/cache-miss token counts when provider reports them
known estimated CNY, unresolved reserved upper CNY, unknown-call count
document ingestion time/local compute cost separately as measured or unknown

cost_math.total: SUM(all model call costs attributable to all four queries, including answer, routing/probe, build, retry/recovery and delayed background calls); retain unresolved reservation separately
cost_math.comparison: (baseline_total - build_total) / baseline_total only if both totals settled, baseline_total > 0 and all paired answers correct; report signed result, including increased cost
cost_math.incremental_reuse: Measure step 3 and 4 incremental calls/tokens/cost after earlier builds are settled; do not omit earlier build expense from total
cost_math.unknown: Do not turn missing usage, unsettled calls or local compute into zero. Stop further paid work when the active cost ledger requires it; mark comparison inconclusive.

go_no_go: Bind exact release commit/config, active budget balance and price snapshot before first real call. This plan neither raises the user total CNY 100 cap nor grants an extra per-plan budget. Root execution owner chooses a bounded reservation and records it.
claims: A 2-issuer paired smoke measurement supports reproducibility, not statistical cost-saving claims or proof of exact supplier prefix-cache insertion/coverage/TTL.
